approval_scope: Up to 66 unique paid text requests for the frozen 24-question development_tune Reliability pilot v0 only.
scope: 24-question development_tune Reliability pilot with C0 closed-book, C1 real retrieval, and C2 Oracle Page
deduplication_rule: For each of the 6 unanswerable questions, C0 and C2 have byte-equivalent model requests and will share one paid response.
expected_cost_method: Historical linear fit from 28 matched successful text requests: estimated input tokens = 182.11181698475355 + 0.2094829125873654 * (question plus evidence characters); historical median output tokens by condition; all input charged at the cache-write multiplier.
conservative_cost_method: For each unique canonical OpenAI request, ceil(request characters / 3) input tokens; all input charged at 1.25 times the uncached input rate; every response uses the full 512-token output limit.
